parole.significato: heron (any of the long-legged, long-necked wading birds of the family Ardeidae)
parole.testo: From Old Galician-Portuguese garça, from Celtiberian *cárcia, from Proto-Celtic *korksā; akin to Welsh crychydd, Breton kerc'heiz. Cognate with Galician, Asturian, and Spanish garza, Mirandese garça and (possibly) Catalan garsa.
